title: BenchMeUp: Building Software Engineering Benchmarks from Natural-Language Specifications
reasons: 材料表明提出方法并使用已有基准评估，未见新基准贡献

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Software-engineering research relies on benchmarks that evaluate new techniques on a set of problem instances.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Checking every constructed instance against its source, the specification, and its expected outcome, we find that 180 of 198 (91\%) meet all criteria, compared with 10 of 200 instances delivered by Codex (general-purpose coding agent).

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Targeting 50 instances per task (200 in total), BenchMeUp constructs 198 instances, of which 196 (99\%) are successfully packaged.
